label:
Calpis-type
milk concentrate
note: Sold as a concentrate and diluted with water or milk before drinking; the yeast stage is what gives the sweet, fruity aroma that a bacteria-only lactic drink lacks.

about.text: A Japanese soft-drink concentrate made by fermenting skimmed milk with lactic acid bacteria and then, after sugar is added, with yeast. Founded by Kaiun Mishima, who was inspired by airag in Mongolia; released 7 July 1919 and diluted before drinking.

steps.note: Skimmed milk is fermented with lactic acid bacteria; species are not published.
Fermented with yeast, which gives the sweetness and fruit-like aroma; species are not published.

processing.text: Skimmed milk is fermented with lactic acid bacteria; then sugar is added and yeast ferments it, which gives the sweetness and fruit-like aroma. Species are not published.

facts.v: Sweetness and fruit-like aroma come from the second fermentation; a first-stage-only lactic drink does not have it
Mishima found that sugar added to lactic-fermented skimmed milk (Daigoso) left overnight mellowed it
